shortDescription: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro are locked in a tight race as Brazil heads into Sunday’s election, according to a pair of new polls.Bloomberg reported the surveys show the two candidates remain in a dead heat.

children: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro are locked in a tight race as Brazil heads into Sunday’s election, according to a pair of new polls.
Bloomberg reported the surveys show the two candidates remain in a dead heat.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Lula, Bolsonaro Tied in Brazil Election Polls
